PSQI global score (psqidurat_i46p2 + psqidistb_i46p2 + psqilaten_i46p2 + psqidaysdys_i46p2 + psqihse_i46p2 + sleepqltyrtng_i46p2 + medsleep_i46p2). Min score = 0 (better), max = 21 (worse). Insight46 phase 2

Days of dysfunction due to sleepiness. Categorized such that if totalscore_i46p2 is = 0 then psqidaysdys_i46p2 = 0, ≥ 1 and ≤ 2 = 1, ≥ 3 and ≤ 4 = 2, and ≥ 5 and ≤ 6 = 3. Min score = 0 (better) and max score = 3 (worse). In PSQI scoring tool, psqidaysdys_i46p2 variable is known as PSQIDAYDYS.  - Insight46 phase 2

Sleep disturbance. Categorized such that if sumscore_i46p2 = 0 then psqidistb_i46p2 = 0, ≥ 1 and ≤ 9 = 1, > 9 and ≤ 18 = 2, and > 18 = 3. Min score = 0 (better) and max score = 3 (worse). In PSQI scoring tool, psqidistb_i46p2 variable is known as PSQIDISTB.  - Insight46 phase 2

Sleep duration. Categorized such that if actslpdur_i46p2 ≥ 7 then psqidurat_i46p2 = 0, < 7 and ≥ 6 = 1, <6 and ≥ 5 = 2, and < 5 = 3. Min score = 0 (better) and max score = 3 (worse). In PSQI scoring tool, psqidurat_i46p2 variable is known as PSQUDURAT.  - Insight46 phase 2

Sleep efficiency.  Categorized such that if tmphse_i46p2 is ≥ 85 then psqihse_i46p2 = 0, < 85 and ≥ 75 = 1, <75 and ≥ 65 = 2, and < 65 = 3. Min score = 0 (better) and max score = 3 (worse). In PSQI scoring tool, psqihse_i46p2 variable is known as PSQIHSE.  - Insight46 phase 2

Sleep latency. Categorized such that if timetoslpcat_i46p2 is = 0 then psqilaten_i46p2 = 0, ≥ 1 and ≤ 2 = 1, ≥ 3 and ≤ 4 = 2, and ≥ 5 and ≤ 6 = 3. Min score = 0 (better) and max score = 3 (worse). In PSQI scoring tool, psqilaten_i46p2 variable is known as PSQILATEN .  - Insight46 phase 2

Derived by finding difference in seconds between bedtime_i46p2 and day wakeuptime_i46p2 and dividing by 3600 to get difference in hours. If >24, then slpdur_i46p2 = difference in hours minus 24, if ≤24, then slpdur_i46p2 = difference in hours.  In PSQI  scoring tool, slpdur_i46p2 variable is nown as newtib. - Insight46 phase 2
Total sleep disturbance score derived by summation of Q5(b) to Q5(j)  - Insight46 phase 2

Categorized such that  if timetoslp_i46p2  ≥ 0 and ≤15 then timetoslpcat_i46p2 = 0, >15 and ≤ 30 = 1, >30 and ≤ 60 = 2, and >60 = 3. In PSQI scoring tool, this variable is known as Q2new - Insight46 phase 2
Percentage of total time spent sleeping in bed. Derived by (actslpdur_i46p2 / slpdur_i46p2) *100. In PSQI scoring tool, tmphse_i46p2 variable is known as tmphse. - Insight46 phase 2
Summation of Q8 and Q9 scores - Insight46 phase 2
